items.rationale: The claim of 'no replication evidence' is contradicted by the submission: repeated stratified nested CV (5 repeats x 5 folds = 25 held-out folds), dummy baselines, bootstrap CIs, calibration diagnostics and deterministic seeds are all present. Convergence-guarantee demands do not apply to the implemented estimators in a meaningful way for this evaluation design; visibility of existing replication evidence will be improved.
items.acceptance_check: Replication evidence made highly visible; response letter documents the contradiction.

items.rationale: The claims of 'only confusion matrix' and 'lacks supportive metrics' are contradicted: the study reports ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, recall, specificity, F1, F2, balanced accuracy, Brier score, calibration slope/intercept, bootstrap CIs, spatial CV, and threshold sweeps. Visibility will be improved and the cited spatial-distribution study reviewed for a fair comparison.
items.acceptance_check: Response letter documents the metrics inventory; visibility improved.

items.rationale: The demand for temporal/dynamic modelling is outside the study scope: the dataset is cross-sectional with no repeated sampling. Adding dynamic filtering or updating procedures without longitudinal data would be unsupported. The absence of temporal validation will be acknowledged explicitly as a limitation and future work; robustness to noise/missing data will be discussed.
items.acceptance_check: Limitations state cross-sectional status and future updating requirements.

items.rationale: The claim that the work has 'no spatial analysis and mapping' is contradicted: spatial clustering (k-means), spatial-group CV, spatial-penalty analysis (Figure 4), cluster metadata, and GIS-ready screening-priority maps (Figure 7) are all present. Visibility of these elements will be improved in the main text.
items.acceptance_check: Spatial elements highly visible; response letter documents the contradiction.
